reading_note: The teaching describes the three foundational principles — Eudaimonia (Good/Blessedness), Sophia (Wisdom), and Power — and traces them through three discrete degrees: in the Father (celestial), in the aeons/cosmos (spiritual), and in the elements (natural). This is precisely Swedenborg's doctrine that Divine Love, Divine Wisdom, and Divine Use proceed from the Lord and exist successively in celestial, spiritual, and natural registers. The arc moves from the highest essential trine in the Divine Itself, through its formation in the heavens, down to its ultimation in the elemental world where the Perfect Man (the Lord in His Human) gathers them all. The earthly counterfeit "eudaimonia of the world in which men boast" is contrasted with the true Blessedness from the Father.
